source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
I need assistance repairing and improving your social media automation funnel.
There are 2 FB, 2 IG, and 1 TK accounts. I want GHL to function like ManyChat.
Scope of Work:
* Examine your current funnel and automation configuration.
* Find and resolve any problems stopping the automation from operating correctly.
* Configure automated responses to comments and likes.
* Create keyword-triggered replies (if applicable).
* Test the full workflow from beginning to end to confirm it works properly.
*Implement any required changes.
